registry_rule.blank_site_id: exclude before response; never recover from response
registry_rule.finite_coordinate_node_definition: include a site only when at least one row has finite numeric Latitude and Longitude inside valid geographic ranges
registry_rule.missing_or_nonfinite_coordinate_row: exclude from spatial registry; no imputation, snapping, borrowing or response-driven recovery
registry_rule.duplicate_site_id_rule: all finite coordinate rows for the same Point_Name must have numerically identical latitude/longitude or the gate stops
registry_rule.response_rows_outside_finite_registry: exclude from all fit, inner-validation and outer-scoring datasets regardless of target value

distance_rule.pair_set: all unordered pairs of distinct unique finite-coordinate Point_Name nodes
distance_rule.quantile_algorithm: sort finite positive pairwise distances; for q use index=(n-1)*q and linear interpolation between floor and ceil

world_family.threshold_values: derived once by the frozen response-independent algorithm and persisted before response access

prediction_support_semantics.local_world_source_to_node_support: 1.0 iff haversine distance from source site to destination site <= that world's frozen distance threshold; otherwise 0.0
